sentence: This project studies how a protein that drives pancreatic cancer stem cells causes resistance to therapies and tests ways to overcome that resistance.
This project studies Alzheimer disease and related dementias through collaborative research across many disciplines.
This project studies the genetic and epigenetic reasons why leukemia cells resist chemotherapy and come back after treatment, using single-cell tools.
This project studies how cells slow down making proteins when they cannot break proteins down.
This project tests a technology to monitor the activity of brain cells called microglia after traumatic brain injury.
This project studies the patterns of adrenal androgens called 11-oxyandrogens in aging men and women and how they relate to health.
This project works to improve an experimental immunotherapeutic nanomedicine for neuroblastoma, testing it in animal models.
This project studies how stress on insulin-producing beta cells leads to hybrid insulin peptides that may trigger the autoimmune response in type 1 diabetes.
This project studies how mutations that change the speed at which a codon is translated can alter protein structure and function.
This project studies how poor fetal growth affects the fetal liver and kidney, and tests treating the placenta with a nanoparticle gene therapy.
This project tests an imaging biomarker that shows a protein kinase in the living human brain.
This project develops and studies nanoparticle immunotherapies that boost innate immunity to fight sepsis.
This project studies how ferroptosis contributes to lethal prostate cancer and tests it as a target for treatment.
This project tests a mobile teledermatology application that lets Veterans get skin care remotely from a dermatologist, and trains AI models on the images.
This project studies how glioblastoma stem-like cells change how they make proteins to survive in low oxygen.
This project studies environmentally-related diseases in children, such as diabetes, obesity, asthma and prematurity.
This project tests whether resistance exercise treats major depression by improving cerebrovascular function, using machine learning to model changes.
This project uses quantitative imaging tools to study the lung and heart in patients with pulmonary thromboembolism and predict their response to treatment.
This project develops enzymatic tests that measure advanced glycation and lipoxidation end products quickly in aging and diabetes.
This project develops advanced optical imaging devices and an AI-based platform to guide treatment decisions during procedures.
